_comment: Non-tsnorm control for the ChEES-HMC gate (Phase 2). Written incrementally as rows land so the numbers survive a restart. WALL TIMES ARE NOT COMPARABLE WITHIN seed 0: the nuts row ran with five sibling fits competing for 24 cores, the chees+precond row with one. Seed 1 onward runs alone and is the clean measurement.

fixture.name: ctl
fixture.why: Notebooks 00/01/05 all use a tsnorm SFH, measured pathologically degenerate in bench/reports/2026-08-20_cuda_device_matrix.md Finding 15 (ESS_min 1.7-4.3 even with 260 spectral pixels). This row swaps ONLY the SFH family so a sampler failure on the notebooks can be told apart from the fixture's own degeneracy.
fixture.sfh: dpl (dual power law, all params free)
fixture.note: Everything except the SFH family is held identical to 05_fitting_photometry, so the pair is a controlled comparison.

platform: Linux, JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, x64, blackjax 1.6.2, optax 0.2.8, 24-core shared box

gate.min_ess: >= mcmc_nuts on the same mock and seed

rows.wall_caveat: measured with five sibling fits on 24 cores; inflated
measured with sibling fits competing; inflated
measured with one or two siblings; least inflated of the three
